releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.14
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.14

This alpha update lets you install, update and remove WoW from the Play screen without opening Battle.net. It also adds a touch layout editor, controller help in Battle.net, and lower CPU use after you enter the world.

Install over your existing version to keep your data.

## What's new

- **Install, update and remove games from Play.** Pick a game version on Play to **Install** it, or pick an installed one to **Play** or **Update**. **Verify** and **Uninstall** sit below **Open Battle.net**. They run through Battle.net's own installer without opening the Battle.net window, and a progress screen shows the download size, speed and time left. Uninstall keeps your add-ons.
- Play shows when the selected game has an update.
- **Account** on Play lists the WoW licenses Battle.net shows for the selected game, such as WoW1 and WoW2. Pick one and Play starts that license. Each game remembers its own choice.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.13
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.13

This alpha update adds a floating game window and automatic Android keyboard support. It also reduces background CPU use and fixes several touch and graphics issues.

Install over your existing version to keep your data.

## What's new

- **Floating game window** is on by default. When you switch apps, the game can keep playing in Android's picture-in-picture window, capped at 20 FPS. Tap the window and use its expand button to return to full screen. You can turn it off in Settings. The background setting is now called **Keep running in background**.
- The Android keyboard opens when a WoW text field gains focus and closes when you finish typing. It stays closed while a hardware keyboard is connected.
- The game surface requests 60 Hz while you play, including during touch input, to reduce display power use on high-refresh-rate phones. WeHavePhones also cleans up leftover Wine processes shortly after a session ends.
- **Disable WoW voice chat** is on by default to reduce background CPU use. Turn it off in Settings if you use WoW's built-in voice chat.

## Touch controls

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.12
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.12

An alpha update fixing a controller regression in 0.0.11.

Install over your existing version to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.**

## Touch controls

- The action wheel is now enabled by default on wide screens. Turn off **Menu → Touch controls → Action wheel** to use standard action bars. Existing saved choices are preserved.

## Fixes

- Moving the left stick on a controller no longer presses the D-pad too, so D-pad bindings in WoW only fire from the D-pad. This fixes a regression in 0.0.11 (#39).

## Validation

- All 14 host suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.
- Forever 1.60.1.70938 passed in the signed 0.0.12 RC on a Galaxy S23+. Controller UI persisted after an in-game exit and relaunch. World entry and jumping passed with default controls.
- Touch controls passed world entry, jumping, stick movement and camera turning. The wheel passed swipes in both directions, hub taps and casting Healing Touch from an existing slot.
- Settings were restored and controller UI returned after the touch tests. No new Android crash entries appeared.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.11
releases.body:
An alpha update with redesigned touch controls, lower graphics memory use and controller fixes.

Install over 0.0.10 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Major change to touch controls

The new touch action wheels have four rings of nine slots using WoW's Action Bars 6 to 8. Swipe around the hub or tap it to change rings, tap a slot to use it, and hold a slot to change it.

**Existing touch-control users may need to re-add their spells and items to the new wheels.**

![Redesigned touch controls with the action wheel](https://github.com/ashmerra/wehavephones/releases/download/v0.0.11/WeHavePhones-0.0.11-touch-controls.png)

## What's new

- Added 75%, 90% and 110% touch interface sizes. The movement stick, toolbar and other native touch controls now resize with the interface, at a gentler rate to keep them easy to tap.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.10
releases.body:
An alpha update focused on touch controls, launch reliability and addon apps.

Install over 0.0.9 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Changes

- Touch chat starts compact when you enter the world and expands when you use it. Its controls stay clear of page keys and the keyboard.
- The touch quest tracker sits below the player frame. Play-mode drags turn the character, and the current touch mode is easier to see.
- Fixed taps missing their target when the Android keyboard pans the game screen.
- Fixed an exited WoW process blocking the next launch.
- Disabled Wine audio codec drivers that delayed Battle.net startup. Previous controlled S23 measurements reached the Play button about six seconds sooner.
- Fixed WowUp hanging at its logo with a backport of Wine's large-message fix. Removed the obsolete WowUp app patch.
- Added automated game and addon app checks for contributors.

## Testing and limitations

- All 13 host check suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.

releases.name: Cemu 2.6
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Exporting saves via the title manager no longer crashes when the export path contains unicode characters
- Fixed a regression in DS Virtual Console titles (#1440)
- Fixed a bug where the debug shader dumping option would try to write files to the wrong directory
- Added a right-click context menu to the PPC debugger disassembly view and fixed some smaller bugs in the debugger
- Use libusb as the backend for HID/USB devices on Windows (#1471)
- Reduce amount of Vulkan sampler objects that are created. Reduces memory usage slightly and avoids crashes on drivers that have a low limit on sampler objects
- Improved index data caching on Vulkan. This may provide a very small performance benefit in some games
- The `--force-interpreter` command line option now always uses single-threaded CPU emulation like originally intended

releases.name: Cemu 2.5
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Upscaling and downscaling options in the graphics settings now work correctly on Vulkan. Previously, the hermite and bicubic scaling options would only work on OpenGL and silently fall back to bilinear filtering on Vulkan
- Graphic pack support for custom scaling shaders has been reworked and is now functional on Vulkan, with fixes carrying over to OpenGL. If you are a graphic pack developer see #1392 for details
- Cemu will now show an error if the MLC directory is not writeable
- Added a workaround for graphic driver crashes seen in the eShop versions of Fatal Frame. These are caused by the game shipping with shaders that contain infinite loops. The actual hardware has an escape mechanism for this that we don't yet emulate
- Added support for connecting Wiimotes via L2CAP on Linux (Details in #1353)
- Set correct version for MacOS bundle
- Updated Arabic, German, Russian and Swedish translations

releases.name: Cemu 2.4
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Added emulated Dimensions Toypad
- Fixed a corruption bug which could occur when reading from titles in .app/.wud/.wux format under rare circumstances
- Cemu will now validate all reads for .app/.wud/.wux format titles and log any detected errors to log.txt. In the future we will also show these errors on screen
- Reworked the Wii U error dialog implementation (ErrEula) for better accuracy. This should fix the bug where sometimes the error dialog was unskippable in some games
- Fixed a bug in the HLE implementation of proc_ui.ProcUIRegisterCallback/ProcUIRegisterBackgroundCallback

releases.name: Cemu 2.3

- Vulkan: Fixed a race condition where uniform data could get corrupted. Most commonly this would cause polygon corruptions in BotW or XCX but in theory could affect every game
- Vulkan: Changes to how frame display is handled to reduce input latency
- Input: Fixed a crash that could occur when closing the add controller dialog while a controller search was still active
- Amiibo: Fixed an issue where Amiibo were not detected in Mario Kart 8
- Online: SpotPass functionality now respects the proxy_server option in settings.xml
- Windows: In portable mode shortcut save icons will now be stored to the Cemu directory instead of %appdata%
- Misc: Fixed a crash that could occur when invalid command line parameters were passed to Cemu

新增：视频实时翻译，识别视频或游戏正在播放的对白，以双语对照悬浮字幕显示原文和译文，没有原字幕也能使用。支持本地模型或在线识别，需要 Android 10 及以上版本。

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.17
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.17: más rendimiento

### Cambios

- **Más rendimiento en procesadores con 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88/G99, MT6769/MT6789 y similares). En la versión anterior dejamos de fijar los hilos del juego a los núcleos rápidos en estos procesadores, y en algunos volvió el lag. Ahora el hilo principal del juego, el que más trabaja, va en los núcleos rápidos, y los demás hilos los reparte Android. Con 4 o más núcleos rápidos no cambia nada: todos los hilos van en ellos.
- **Menos trabajo inútil en cada fotograma.** El juego pregunta por `d3d9.dll` en cada fotograma, y el port lo anotaba en el registro cada vez: unas 2000 líneas por segundo en Most Wanted y Carbon. Ahora se anota una sola vez. Otras líneas repetitivas (texturas convertidas en la CPU, entrada de teclado, liberación de superficies) también se limitan. Además de ahorrar CPU, el registro de los reportes conserva lo importante.
- **Cierres que dejaron de aparecer.** Con la versión anterior ya no hemos vuelto a ver el cierre más repetido de Most Wanted al arrancar, ni el de Underground 2 en la preparación de los reflejos. Si te vuelve a pasar, envía el reporte desde el launcher.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.16
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.16: LAN sin bloqueos y reportes más completos

### Cambios

- **Crear carrera LAN ya no detiene el juego si tu `server.dll` es de otra versión.** Antes salía "Arranque guest detenido: server.dll: file layout does not match the lifted code" y el juego se paraba. Ahora aparece un aviso: ese teléfono no puede crear la carrera, pero sí unirse a una que cree otro jugador. Para crearla, copia el `server.dll` de la misma instalación de PC de donde sacaste el ejecutable del juego.
- **Rendimiento recuperado en procesadores con solo 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88, MT6769 y similares). Desde la versión anterior, todos los hilos del juego se fijaban a los núcleos rápidos. En estos procesadores eso los metía todos en solo 2 núcleos, y el juego iba peor que antes. Ahora solo se fijan cuando hay al menos 4 núcleos rápidos; si no, Android los reparte como antes.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15: driver recomendado para tu GPU

### Driver Vulkan recomendado para tu procesador

- **El launcher te dice qué driver usar.** En *Opciones › Driver Vulkan* ahora aparece la GPU de tu teléfono y el driver que le conviene:
  - **Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx):** Turnip (Mesa), si el driver del sistema va lento o con errores gráficos.
  - **MediaTek, Exynos, Tensor o Unisoc con Mali-G57 o más nueva:** PanVK (Mesa), con la misma condición.
  - **Mali-G52/G72/G76 o más antiguas:** el driver del sistema (PanVK aún es experimental en ellas).
  - **PowerVR (Moto g54, Helio G35/G37…) y Samsung Xclipse:** el driver del sistema. No hay un driver alternativo que funcione en ellas.
- **Aviso si el driver no es para tu GPU.** Si eliges un driver hecho para otra GPU (por ejemplo, Turnip en una Mali o PanVK en una Adreno), el launcher avisa de que el juego probablemente no arrancará.

La app no incluye ningún driver: los importas tú como ZIP (adrenotools) desde el mismo diálogo.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14: volver al juego sin cierres y reportes completos

Revisamos los reportes de la v0.1.13. La protección para GPU PowerVR funcionó: el Moto g54 ya pasa del primer dibujo. Esta versión corrige el cierre más repetido y hace que los reportes traigan la información que necesitamos.

### Correcciones

- **Cierre al volver al juego.** Si salías a otra app y volvías, el juego podía cerrarse en el primer fotograma. Android libera la ventana del juego al pasar a segundo plano, pero la superficie Vulkan seguía usándola y se destruía después. Ahora la superficie conserva su ventana hasta que se destruye.

### Reportes más útiles

- **El resumen del issue ya trae las líneas del juego.** Antes se tomaban de logcat y, cuando pulsabas *Reportar*, Android ya las había borrado: casi todos los issues llegaban con "últimas líneas del juego" vacío. Ahora salen del registro propio del juego (`game.log`), y logcat solo aporta las líneas del cierre.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13: mega actualización

Revisamos uno por uno los reportes y los zip de diagnóstico que nos enviaron. Esta versión corrige los fallos más repetidos y añade lo necesario para que los próximos reportes traigan toda la información.

### Gráficos

- **Detalle de las sombras ya se puede activar.** El juego solo habilita esa opción con tarjetas NVIDIA o ATI. Ahora el port se presenta como una NVIDIA GeForce 7800 GTX, así que la opción se puede subir y las sombras se dibujan en carrera.
- **Texturas DXT1 con transparencia correcta.** Se convierten a A1R5G5B5, como ya hace Carbon: menos memoria y bordes recortados correctos.
- **Protección para GPU PowerVR (MediaTek, p. ej. Moto g54 / Dimensity 7020).** El driver Vulkan de MediaTek se caía al crear el primer pipeline gráfico, en los cuatro juegos. Ahora, si el driver falla, el port reintenta con configuraciones más simples hasta encontrar una que funcione. *No hemos podido probarlo en un teléfono PowerVR; si tienes uno, cuéntanos cómo va.*

### Estabilidad

releases.name: 2.1 - November 18, 2026
releases.body: * **Start straight into a game (Wii).** Name a game when you launch DOSBox Wii and it starts with that game's config on top of `dosbox.conf`: from the Homebrew Channel (`<arguments>` in `meta.xml`) or from WiiFlow, either as a plugin (the zip now includes `wiiflow/plugins/dosbox-wii.ini`, which lists the `.conf` files in `DOSBox/Games` as games) or from its Homebrew list. A game can be named as `-gameconf <conf or folder>`, as a bare `.conf`, or as a bare folder that holds one (`autoboot.conf`, or its only `.conf`). A relative name is looked for as written, beside the launched `boot.dol`, then in the `DOSBox` folder, so a game's `.conf`, `.map` and files can all live in one folder, anywhere. If the game cannot be found DOSBox starts without one and says why on the DOS screen. The **Status** page has an **Autoboot** row, and the app now knows it was started this way (`IsAutoboot()`), ready for a single-game menu later. See the README's *Starting a game at launch*

releases.name: 2.0 - October 25, 2026
releases.body:
* **A new port.** DOSBox Wii has been rebuilt on the same [libgui](https://github.com/dborth/libgui) interface and driver framework as the other GX emulators, and no longer uses SDL. The DOSBox core is stock SVN r4301, and one codebase now builds for both the Wii and the Wii U
* **Wii U release!** DOSBox Wii now runs natively on the Wii U as its own app, with its own icon on the Wii U Menu. Requires [Aroma](https://wiiu.hacks.guide/) - run the latest Aroma release and launch the `.wuhb` directly from it
  * Full **Wii U GamePad** support - touch screen and buttons - alongside Wiimote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller and Wii U Pro Controller
  * SD card plus up to 3 USB drives, mounted from the new **Drives** screen. USB supports FAT32, exFAT and NTFS (requires [Mocha](https://github.com/wiiu-env/MochaPayload), an optional Aroma component)
  * Recommended: install [Bloopair](https://github.com/GaryOderNichts/Bloopair) to pair Bluetooth controllers (Switch Pro, Joy-Con, DualShock/DualSense, Xbox, and more) as if they were a Wii U Pro Controller

The **Status** page has an **Autoboot** row, and the app now knows it was started this way (`IsAutoboot()`), ready for a single-game menu later. See the README's *Starting a game at launch*

DolphinVR Redux v0.5 brings VR game patches, which put your hands and your head into the games themselves, an in-game menu you use without taking the headset off, a large round of Meta Quest performance work, and automatic updates on Windows.

- **VR game patches.** The arm cannon follows your controller in the Metroid Prime games, the gun and sword follow it in Red Steel 1 and 2, Skyward Sword reads your controller's true pose, and Twilight Princess, The Wind Waker, Wii Sports and Shadow the Hedgehog can be played in first person.

- **Rebased on the latest Dolphin** development builds (October 2026).

releases.name: FEX Release FEX-2611
releases.body:
# Read the blog post at [FEX-Emu's Site!](https://fex-emu.com/FEX-2611/)
You know the drill, it's been around a month so that means we have a new release landing. A smattering of changes all over the codebase this time.
Let's see what's interesting!

## CPU core index through TPIDRRO_EL0
This is a fun feature that has come about primarily because Windows on ARM mandates this feature. The [TPIDRRO_EL0](https://support.arm.com/documentation/ddi0601/2026-09/AArch64-Registers/TPIDRRO-EL0--EL0-Read-Only-Software-Thread-ID-Register?lang=en) register
is an ARM system register that is readable by userspace that the kernel can set to whatever 64-bit value it wants. In particular under Windows it is

releases.name: Xenoblade DE port v0.16.1
releases.body:
## Runtime update (no visible change in this port)

This release carries a fix from the Catherine port's runtime, which both ports share.

Some games bind a block of shader constants that is shorter than what their shader actually reads. On the console the bytes just past the block are the next bytes of the game's own structure; the port was filling them with zeros. It now copies them from the game's memory up to the next 16-byte boundary and keeps zeros beyond that.

**Nothing changes in Xenoblade: its G-buffer vertex shader reads up to 368 bytes with 256 bound, and 256 is already a multiple of 16, so it keeps getting zeros — exactly as before.** Re-verified on the Flip 2 with a copy of the save: characters whole (Shulk with the Monado, the party), 30.1 fps in battle, saves untouched.

## En español

Esta versión trae un arreglo del runtime que comparte con el port de Catherine.

releases.name: Xenoblade DE port v0.16.0
releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

Two new rows in the settings panel (swipe in from the right edge of the screen):

- **Save report** writes a folder `reports/<date>/` into your game folder: the log, a screenshot of the moment you opened the panel, the frame times of the last seconds and basic device information (model, Android version, memory). **Nothing is sent anywhere.** If something looks wrong, open an [issue](https://github.com/IamWilmar/xenoblade-recomp/issues) and attach those files (have a look first: the log contains the names of your folders).
- **Update notices** (on by default): about eight seconds after the game starts, the app asks GitHub's public API which release is the latest. It is a single request, without an account, and nothing about you or your game is sent. If there is a newer version, a banner says so and *Get vX.Y.Z* opens its page. Switch it off in the panel (or create an empty file `sin_avisos_version` in the game folder) and the app makes no network request at all.
- Because of the update notices the app now has Android's **Internet** permission. It is used for that request only.

releases.name: v0.14.0
releases.body:
## Sharper 3D

- **The 3D image is upscaled with AMD FSR 1 before the game adds its interface.** The game draws its 3D at a dynamic resolution (for example 704×416 in handheld mode) and stretched it to its 720p window with a simple filter; on the Flip 2 that 720p image was then stretched again to the 1080p screen. Now FSR rebuilds the 3D at 720p first, and the step to 1080p sharpens instead of only stretching. The interface is untouched. The difference is largest in TV mode, where the 3D is narrowest.
- It costs about 2.8 ms of GPU per frame and turns itself off for a moment when a heavy scene would not fit in the 30 fps frame. Measured on the Flip 2 in the open field: 30 fps in handheld and TV mode.

# WWE '12 PC 1.5.0 "Small PCs"

This version is about PCs with few or slow CPU cores: a start-up freeze is fixed, parts of the game run faster, and there is a new FPS counter. It also fixes two Universe problems.

## Fixes

- **Fixed a rare freeze on "NOW LOADING" at start-up** on PCs with few or slow CPU cores (a race between the game's sound-bank loading threads). The game could stay on the first loading screen forever. On a test PC limited to 2 slow cores it froze in 2 starts out of 10 before the fix and never in 10 starts after it (#69, #74: if your freeze has another cause, tell us). 
- **No more loading-screen speed-up on PCs with fewer than 8 usable threads**, where it could lock the game at its frame barrier.
- **Universe: SmackDown (and other weekly shows) no longer end up with only 0-1 match** when their roster is small: a match that would be dropped because everyone is resting now takes a rested Superstar instead.

releases.name: WWE '12 PC 1.4.1
releases.body:
# WWE '12 PC 1.4.1

A small update after 1.4.0: a Royal Rumble crash fixed, and belt modding in the Mod Maker.

## Fixes

**WWE '12 PC v1.3.0 — "Speed and fixes"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Faster
- **Loading screens shorter** (a match loads in about 1.5 s instead of 4 s, the end of the entrances in about 1.9 s instead of 4.5 s). `wwe12_fast_loading = false` brings the old behaviour back.
- **Faster start-up** on PCs with 8 or more logical processors: the title screen comes after about 5-7 s instead of 15 s. On smaller processors the normal start-up is kept (`wwe12_fast_boot_min_threads`).
- **Sharper picture** when the game is drawn at 720p on a bigger screen (`svr_upscale_sharpness`, 0 turns it off).
- **Adaptive V-sync**: a late frame is shown at once instead of waiting a whole refresh (`svr_adaptive_vsync`).
- **Performance test** in the launcher (button *Performance test*): it plays a recorded 1-on-1 match with entrances once and tells you if your PC is fine, limited by the processor or by the graphics card. Nothing is changed without your agreement.

### Frame rate

**WWE '12 PC v1.2.0 — "Moveset update"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Fixed
- **Match-start stutter (and a short freeze) on integrated graphics (Intel...)**: the game's reads of the picture back from the graphics card are now grouped at the end of the frame (about 10 times less waiting at the start of a match). `svr_readback_defer_streak = false` goes back to 1.1.
- **Less work for the processor every frame** (helps small PCs, issue #53): shader constants are reused like on Android (`svr_reuse_constant_blocks`) and the check of 3D models is lighter (`svr_geometry_sample_min`, 32768 brings the 1.1 behaviour back).
- **Crash at start with file names that have accents or other characters** (for example a song called "Café.mp3" or a mod folder with Japanese letters in a mod): names are now read as UTF-8 everywhere in the game, the launcher and the Mod Maker, and a mod with an unreadable name is skipped instead of closing the game.

releases.name: Zaxnes 0.6.0
releases.body:
This one is mostly about what happens *under* the 3D. The emulator itself got a lot better.

## New

**Accuracy: 147 of 147 on AccuracyCoin.** 0.5.0 passed 128. Zaxnes was also compared cycle by cycle with a transistor-level simulation of the NES chips (421,901 CPU cycles, DMA included), and the timing matched. Where the two still differ, tests made on real consoles side with Zaxnes.

**Over 400 mappers.** Up from 144. That includes the **Famicom Disk System**, the **VS. System** with its cabinet buttons, and newer boards like the Rainbow.

**A fast core.** It skips work the screen doesn't need, but gives the same results as the accurate core. We checked that frame by frame on 320 ROMs. Handhelds use it by default.

**New options window.** One slider goes from *Fastest* to *Most faithful* and sets everything that costs speed. A simple mode shows only what most people need, and an advanced mode shows everything. It works the same on the PC and on the console screen.

releases.name: Zaxnes 0.5.0
releases.body:
Zaxnes is an independent project, not affiliated with Geod Studio or Nintendo.

## Highlights

**3dSen 2.0 and 2.1 compatibility.** Profiles from 3dSen 2.0 and 2.1 import and play, with what the new versions brought: reflections, bend, the new camera and Lua features.

**A real NES emulator, not just a gimmick.** Mapper support goes from 85 to 144, and AccuracyCoin from 89 to 128 tests out of 147. More accuracy work is coming in the next releases.

**New widescreen hacks: Kirby's Adventure and Faxanadu.** Every regional version of each. Faxanadu already has its 3D profile in this release; Kirby's is on the way.

**Smooth scrolling at 120 Hz (experimental).** On a 120 Hz screen, the playfield is drawn between two emulated frames, from the run-ahead.

**RetroArch shaders.** Slang shaders (through librashader) on the Vulkan / DirectX 12 renderer: CRT, scanlines, LCD, Mega Bezel TV frames. A pack of presets is built in, separately for 2D and 3D. Available on Android too.

**Editor mode for 3D profiles (work in progress).** An AI-assisted editor: it gives an AI agent a harness through a local MCP server, and a prompt ready to copy and paste. Expect more on it in the next release.

## Security: Steam token redaction in logs

GameHub Lite 5.1.8 fixes a logging issue where Steam authentication-related values could appear in diagnostic logs. 
In some cases, logs could include fields such as `steamToken`, `refreshToken`, or `accessToken` from Steam login/launch flows.

**Publicly posted logs containing these fields should be deleted or redacted.**

### IMPORTANT

This should go without saying but If you find any security issues, please reach out **PRIVATELY**. 
I have not checked if this issue is still present in recent GameHub versions, already ruined my one day off I was spending with my family by the person who reported this publicly and I do not plan on spending any more time on this.

### Changelog

The fix adds centralized log redaction for Steam/auth token fields, Steam QR login URLs, JWT-like token strings, and launch command token arguments before logs are written. This covers the app loggers, JavaSteam logging, and the PC launch-log file writer.

This release also pins local patch builds to `apktool 2.12.1`

# GameHub Lite v5.1.6

This release fixes an actual app-side launch issue, and yes, also exists because apparently backend fixes do not count unless there is a fresh APK attached to a GitHub release.

The main app fix is for devices where GameHub would silently refuse to launch games when the `getUnknownDevices` / `startType` API path returned a `404`. Instead of failing closed and doing absolutely nothing, the app now falls back like it already did for the no-internet path.

Confirmed affected and fixed:

- AYANEO Pocket FIT
- Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 / Adreno 750
- Android 14

### Backend changes

More work happened in [gamehub-lite-api](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api), because that is where a lot of compatibility and component delivery work lives now.

Backend changes since the `v5.1.5` release include:

- Updated simulator response timestamps so stale responses get refreshed.
- Added release asset verification and MD5 checks for GitHub release assets.
- Updated component manifests, timestamps, deprecated component removal, and total counts.
- Cleaned up SteamAgent2 manifest naming.
- Removed drivers that were already added in the latest GameHub manifest.

releases.name: v11.5
releases.body:
## v11.5 摘要

**批量 / 扫描导入** — 导入向导第一步新增「批量扫描导入（多选）」：选一个目录（例如 Download），用 SAF 扫出候选——顶层带 `.exe` / `.rpy` / `.rpyc` / `.xp3` / `.rpa` / `.ypf` / `.wolf` / `.rgssad` / `.nsa` 之一，或是 Ren'Py 的 `game/` 目录；套娃目录只下探一层，跳过隐藏目录与运行时目录。勾选后**串行**导入，每条独立汇报「等待 / 复制中 / 导入中 / 已导入 / 失败」，失败项复用单条导入的回滚（删已建容器根目录 + 清暂存）。批量**不**自动拉起内置引擎，导完统一回游戏库自己点。

**分类过滤由「单选」升级为「三维组合」** — 引擎 + 品类 + 标签可同时生效（AND），同一维度再点一次取消；筛空时空态文案改为「没有匹配的游戏」。「继续游玩」改为按最后启动时间倒序且只收真启动过的（`lastPlayedAt > 0`）——此前是「列表前 3 个」，名不副实；没玩过任何游戏时整段隐藏。

**封面（提取修复 + 用户自定义）** — ①`BitmapFactory` 解不了 PE 资源里的原始 DIB，所以卡片封面一直是占位图；新增 `IconCodec` 兜底（补 14 字节 `BITMAPFILEHEADER`、`biHeight` 减半剥掉 AND 掩码层、按 8bpp 调色板算偏移），组内候选按字节数降序逐个重试——真机上那款 Unity 游戏的 exe 图标首次正常显示。②详情页「维护 → 封面」可**从相册选图**或**恢复自动**，优先级 自定义 > 目录图 > exe 图标；选图先落 `.tmp` 并实际解码一次，解不开的不落盘。③修「换完封面回列表仍显示占位图」：解码完成前同一位置可能已被重绑到另一个 View，旧逻辑只贴给回调持有者；现在解码完成后让列表按缓存位图重画一次。

**UI 修正（真机实测出来的）** — 多选条加「品类 / 标签」后，六个动作把「已选 N 项」挤成 0 宽、「完成」被截断：标签简化为「删除 / 移除」、收紧边距、计数给最小宽度，全部回到一行内。「彻底删除 / 仅移除」确认弹窗从**只报数量**改为**列出游戏名**，并写明原生游戏的收纳副本同样会被删（真机复验时因只报数量误删过一批，当场从仍在的源目录重新导入恢复）。

releases.name: v11.4
releases.body:
## v11.4 摘要

**导入重做** — 第一步从「手输路径」换成系统文件夹选择器（`ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE` + persistable 授权），授权跟目录走、不随卸载重装重置；所选目录先复制进应用私有暂存（带进度、失败清半成品、可用空间 <128MB 硬失败、6h 残骸清扫）再走原管线。

**导入假成功链（真机事故 D1–D5）** — 重装后「所有文件访问」被系统重置时 `listFiles()` 为 null，旧行为一路「成功」到启动才报「启动文件缺失」：现 step0 fail-fast 并带用户去授权页。同批修复：解压套娃目录归一（`resolveGameRoot`，JVM 回归 E15–E21）、库条目回填标题/引擎、CJK 目录名塌缩改附哈希后缀、容器名恒等 `galgame-<gameId>`（避让上移到 id 派生）、导入失败回滚已建容器、复制完成无 exe 当场告警、重复导入先确认。

**游戏库分类** — 顶部 chips 单选过滤：引擎自动归类（多于一种才出现）、预置内容品类（视觉小说 / 文字冒险 / 其他）、自定义标签；长按多选后「品类 / 标签」可一次给多张卡归类，标签可内联新建。

**数据安全三件** — ①「彻底删除」补删 `files/galgame-native` 收纳副本（此前数 GB 静默泄漏）并校验结果；②索引改 `.tmp`+`fsync`+rename 原子写，解析失败先隔离 `.corrupt-<ts>` 再重建；③存档管理器拒绝空 gameId（跨游戏串档），便携存档「先搬后链」改为合并不完整就不删源、链接失败把档拷回、同名冲突留 `.bak`。

**运维事实（重要）** — 卸载重装 / 清数据会重置全部文件权限（含「所有文件访问」），ColorOS/Android 16 上 shell 无法代授，只能用户手动开；新的导入流程不依赖该权限。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包 11.4：选择器全链路（Download → 游戏目录 → 使用此文件夹）→ 检测 UNITY / 5 个文件 → 导入 → 单卡启动 → 标题菜单 → 正片连续推进对白 100s+；分类三条链路（品类/标签/引擎 chips，筛选取值 1/1/2）；把索引写成非法 JSON 后改一次分类 → 旧文件留档、新索引字段正确；注入 2MB 收纳副本后彻底删除 → 目录归空。

releases.name: v11.3
releases.body:
## v11.3 摘要

**界面** — Swiss 单首页 IA 与全站视觉重构：内页与游戏内 UI 收进同一套视觉语言；明暗双档走同一套主题 token（`values-night` 反相，状态栏图标随档位切换）；「设置 → 输入控制」从死路接成真入口；运行环境可管理（详情 / 重新注入语言字体 / 删除）。

**引擎** — 指纹扩展到 **19 个**（Siglus / YU-RIS / Artemis / CatSystem2 / AdvHD / SystemNNN / BGI / CMVS / Unity 等）；新增 `detectDeep()` 有限深度下钻（深度 ≤3、预算 4000 项），修子目录 `.xp3` 被判 UNKNOWN 后无法升级路由的问题。

**稳定性** — 修复 X server 输出流的静默截断与 SIGPIPE：`XOutputStream_send` 由裸阻塞 `write()` 改为 `send(MSG_NOSIGNAL)` 循环写满，EINTR 重试、EAGAIN 时 `poll` 上限 2 秒。

**工程** — box64 自建变成可复现资产（私有补丁导出 + 双向校验 + 构建脚本 + 打包器入库，版本不再写死）；类型门禁修绿（热点清单 3 → 6 条、`R` 桩 100 → 183 符号）；运行时资源 SHA-256 清单补齐 `assets` 子目录（34 → 57 个文件）。

**已知限制** — 走 DirectShow 的引擎（SystemNNN / YU-RIS 等）过场动画仍黑屏。根因已定位到 Wine 内建 quartz 的 `IVideoWindow::put_WindowStyle` → `SetWindowPos` 跨线程 `SendMessage` 永不返回（`IMediaControl::Run` 从未被调用），属 Wine 侧问题、应用层不可改，登记为 TD-09。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包：库页 19 条正常、详情页与设置页正常、版本号显示 11.3、锚点《花瓣！》`HANA9cn.EXE` 经 UI 完整路径启动并渲染标题画面。

releases.body:
**New — Frame Generation (experimental)**
- **Frame Generation ships as an opt-in**: toggle it live in the Quick-Access blade (L3+R3) or per
  game in settings. It runs AMD FidelityFX optical-flow frame interpolation inside Ryudeck's own
  Vulkan present path — no external layers — presenting an interpolated frame between each pair of
  real frames on a dedicated present thread. GPU-light titles roughly double their perceived
  frame rate (measured on device: ~21-30 fps rendered → ~42-60 presented).
- It is self-limiting by design: generation only engages when it actually helps — it suspends below
  a per-title frame-rate floor, when the GPU has no spare headroom (measured from real per-frame GPU
  time, so misreported "100% busy" titles are handled), and when the game already runs near panel
  rate. A zero-delay dip veto skips generation for any single spiked frame (e.g. a shader-compile
  stall), so sudden hitches are never smeared into interpolated frames.
- Fixed: the feature now engages reliably on every launch (previously a first-launch state could
  latch process-wide), the blade reports its live state honestly (including a "restart game" hint

releases.body:
Automated build of `master` at 6c33e98bdf74755273b6e535d1c903bbe7d58508.

These are untested snapshots and may be broken. For stable builds use the [latest release](https://github.com/shanytc/snes9x/releases/latest).

**GUIs** (`super-snes9x-nightly-*`): Windows: unzip and run. Linux: `chmod +x` the AppImage. macOS: the app is universal (Intel + Apple Silicon) and self-signed, so after copying it run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine super-snes9x-qt.app`.

**libretro cores** (`supersnes9x_libretro-nightly-*`): unzip the core and its `.info` file into RetroArch's cores directory. The macOS core is a universal x86_64 + arm64 binary.

# Lua Scripting
- Added Lua 5.4 scripting: `File > Script > Lua` opens a script editor on win32, Qt and GTK, with syntax colouring, line numbers, completion, an API reference, a console and session restore.
- Added a script debugger: breakpoints (with conditions, hit counts and log messages), Step Into / Over / Out, Break on Errors, and Variables, Watch, Call Stack and Breakpoints panels.
- 28 example scripts under `Help > Examples`: FPS Counter, Sprite Boxes, RAM Heat Map, Input Display, Cheat Finder, Trace Logger and more.
- `-lua <script>` runs a script from the command line.
- `gui.set_antialias` smooths lines, circles, ellipses and polygons.
- No speed cost while no script is loaded.
- Guide and API reference: [Lua scripting](https://github.com/shanytc/snes9x/blob/master/docs/lua-scripting.md)

# Enhancement Chips (DSP-1/2/3/4, Cx4)
- DSP-1, DSP-1B, DSP-2, DSP-3, DSP-4 and the Cx4 now run as native chips that match their firmware instruction for instruction, with no dump needed.
- Each chip can also run its firmware dump (new BIOS Manager slots), or the old HLE.

# Nintendo Super System
- Added Nintendo Super System arcade support: Z80 supervisor, 
- key chip, on-screen display, three cartridge sockets and the front panel.
- Twelve of the thirteen dumped cartridges run, including HiROM and DSP-1 boards.
- Named the cartridge DIP switches for ActRaiser, The Addams Family, Lethal Weapon and Robocop 3.
- The supervisor's reset silences the APU too, Restart has to be held as on the cabinet, and nocash's test program is accepted as a BIOS.
- The joypad watchdog is off by default. Fixes Lethal Weapon being thrown off the machine.
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Nintendo Super Disc
- Added support for the BIOS in the BIOS Manager.
- Added support for disc insert and eject (eject resets to the home screen), and the disc's name in the window title.
- Working Titles:
  - Super Boss Gaiden
  - Test CD, [sdtest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32607729/sdtest.zip)
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Super Famicom Box
- The keyswitch position is remembered, and the window title names the running game.

# Super Game Boy Color (new, Experimental)
- New SGBC mode: an SGB2 with a Game Boy Color inside with customs borders support.
- This mode runs a memory patched SGB2 BIOS with per-game in-memory patch to support colors and borders.
- Color now comes from the cart instead of the stale SGB palette. 
- Pre-palette fallback goes through BGP.
- DMG-compatibility color is routed through BGP/OBP.
- Carts whose SGB detect beats the Color branch get dedicated patches.
- Note: not all games might work out of the box - some issues might occur during game play / boot.

# Super Game Boy
- MLT_REQ is latched in the ICD2 instead of waiting for the BIOS.
- BIOS mode carries its cycle remainder instead of flooring twice, and deducts GB cycle overshoot (fixes audio pacing).
- Packet bits latch on the rising edge, not the falling one.
- MASK_EN honored on the BIOS pane, LCD-off treated as a freeze.
- Boot logo held on displayed content, hidden under the SGB BIOS, and shown only when a boot ROM was actually assigned.
- GBC-only carts are no longer forced out of SGB BIOS mode on the container path.
- Sprite-limit hack offered in SGB BIOS sessions.

## Voicer-kun

Changes:

- Fix authentication for registries without token service: Nexus, Artifactory and htpasswd-protected servers.
- Report bad `PD_DOCKER_AUTH` credentials before initiating install or push session.

releases.name: Version 5.10.1
releases.body:
Changes:

* `install`, `push`: better handling for registry rate limits (HTTP 429) by honoring `Retry-After`, show detailed error when rate limit occurs while using a shared Docker Hub frontend (proxy) instead of raw `Network error: HTTP Error 429`.

Notice for users: this does not resolve issue with rate limits imposed by Docker Hub registry. Such issue just can't be resolved at proot-distro side because restriction applies to client IP address, which in case of NAT (CG-NAT) or proxy may be shared between large amount of devices.

Don't submit bug reports if encounter HTTP 429!

Workaround:

1. Create Docker Hub account.
2. Use `export PD_DOCKER_AUTH="username:password"` or `export PD_DOCKER_AUTH="username:personal-access-token"`, the personal access token must be created through account settings with permissions at least for read-only access.

releases.name: Version 5.10.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- refs: Image names are now checked using Docker's rules. Malformed names are refused with a clear message.
- install: Added support for images pinned by digest, e.g. `ubuntu@sha256:...`. The download is verified against the digest. A pinned image can be reinstalled from the cache without network.
- build, push: A digest is refused in `build -t` and `push`.
- install: Fixed intact image layers sometimes refused with "does not match its digest".
- http: Redirects can no longer move a download from HTTPS to plain HTTP. `--allow-insecure` lifts this.
- registry: `--allow-insecure` no longer applies to Docker Hub. It is always verified.
- http: Network requests give up after 2 minutes of silence instead of hanging forever.
- http: Invalid URLs and registry addresses now show an error message instead of a traceback.
- build, login: Bytes that are not valid UTF-8 in arguments, build args or image environment no longer cause a traceback.
- list, remove: `--image` no longer prints control characters from cache entries as they are.
- sync, copy: Files that change during the transfer are handled correctly. No more missed updates or wrong permissions.

releases.name: Version 5.9.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- `login`, `run`: export variables `PD_CONTAINER=<name>`, `PD_IMAGE=<image-ref>`, `PD_IMAGE_ID=<sha256-digest>` and `container=proot-distro` in sessions. Build gets same except `PD_CONTAINER`.
- `pull`: detect whether image config or manifest is shorter than `Content-Length`.
- `build` (ADD, COPY): placing directory over an existing regular file is now a refusal instead of a silent tree/layer mismatch.
- `build` (... --chmod): validate value as an octal between 0 and 07777.
- `build`: Dockerfile is read with 16 MiB limit.
- `push`: send the Bearer token on the upload PUT only when the Location URL belongs to the registry itself.
- Registry credentials are only sent to the origin they were addressed to.
- Do not carry Authorization header if host redirects from HTTPS to HTTP.
- A token endpoint realm must be `https://` (`http://` allowed under --allow-insecure). `file://`, `ftp://` and `data:` realms are refused.
- Environment strings from image config are validated before exec (no NUL, encodable, under 128 KiB).
- The `profile.d` snippet is written for every session of a normal-type container, not only default-mode Termux logins.

releases.name: Version 0.30.6
releases.body:
# Skyrim for Android 0.30.6

APK: `Skyrim-0.30.6.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).

## New
- "Disable end-of-frame image space (post-processing)" option. It does the same as the TEOFIS console command at every launch. It fixes the black world map and solid-colour underwater screen, but it also turns off all end-of-frame post-processing (tonemapping, bloom, colour grading and depth of field), so the game looks more naturally lit.
- "Asynchronous rendering" option. It's off by default and when it's on, shaders compile on background threads. New effects may pop in for a frame or two instead of causing a hitch. 

## Fixed
- Shader caching is removed. The DXVK state cache rebuilt every saved pipeline on 5 extra threads at startup, which took CPU away from the game's main thread and caused crashes on Mali devices. Nothing is cached between launches now, and the game runs better overall.
- Traps triggering freezes was due to failed lookups with vertex optimization. The function has been turned off for now.
- Audio in other languages - the decoder was reading each WMA bitstream but with the wrong block-size config. Should be working now.

Hotfix release following 0.3.0: fixes a frame-pacing and input-latency regression in input polling, eliminates shader-translation busy-wait CPU spikes, adds a 20 FPS limiter option, and enables full resolve readback automatically for FIFA Street (2012).

* Enable `readback_resolve = "all"` automatically for FIFA Street (2012) so indoor pitches render with proper colors (#114)

releases.name: Xendroid+ 0.3.0
releases.body:
Scheduler and file I/O fixes from upstream Xenia Edge: file reads and writes finish the way they do on the console, and kernel timers and DPCs behave like the console's.

Adds ZeroFG frame generation: the screen shows twice the game's frame rate (30 → 60, 60 → 120).

Halo: Reach runs much faster and shows the characters' faces again: from 17 to its limit of 30 fps in the first mission on a POCO F7 (Adreno 825).

Gears of War 3 returns to its 30 fps cap in its opening checkpoint on a POCO F7 (Adreno 825), cutting GPU frame time by 37% (44.9 to 28.2 ms).

Game folder management after initial setup, a 40 FPS frame rate cap for 120 Hz displays, lower power draw and heat on Android, and improved physical controller trigger and remapping support.

Upstream Xenia Edge synchronization (batch 16) bringing 40 audio, kernel, scheduler, threading and CPU fixes, plus an ARMv8.0 JIT fix for older Snapdragon chips.

Improves Vulkan startup compatibility on older Adreno GPUs, ports rendering accuracy fixes from Xenia Edge, and reduces vertex shader overhead when software round-toward-zero emulation is active.

releases.body:
# YukiHub v0.4.5 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**四平台游玩状态同步 · Hikarinagi 快捷登录优化 · SD 卡目录授权 · 稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **同步游玩状态至四个平台**：现在可以把本地的游玩时长与进度，一键同步到 **NextMoe·未萌（鲲 Galgame）**、**VNDB**、**Bangumi** 与 **Hikarinagi**。四个平台的入口统一收进个人资料页的「同步游玩状态」折叠卡，点开后按平台逐项操作，状态一目了然。
- **Hikarinagi 快捷登录支持邮箱识别**：现在用 Hikarinagi 快捷登录时会一并读取邮箱，若该邮箱已在 YukiHub 注册过，**将直接登录并绑定到原账号**，与 NextMoe·未萌 的行为完全一致，不再另开新号、云同步数据也不会分裂。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **内置 Gal 工具箱常规维护**：同步更新内置工具箱里的网址与内容，保持可用。
- **同步进度弹窗重做**：进度展示改为环形进度 + 分步状态，四个平台的同步过程都能清楚看到当前在做什么。
- **新增取消绑定游玩状态同步凭证**:打开对应窗口后，长按即可弹出取消，清空凭证以重新登陆。
- **bangumi游戏自定义查询新增id查询**:因api缺陷，部分游戏不能直接搜到，因此新增了id搜索，在自定义搜索界面，直接输入数字is即可。

## 🛠 问题修复

- **修复 NextMoe 源封面模糊的问题**：部分作品封面会取到低分辨率图，现已修正取图逻辑。
- **修复通知权限疯狂弹窗的问题**：此前会反复请求通知权限，现已正常。
- **修复 SD 卡授权时选不到指定文件夹的问题**：内置文件选择器新增 SD 卡支持，现在可以正常选中 SD 卡里的游戏目录。

## 📌 说明

- **同步范围**：VNDB 不支持通过 API 写入游玩时长，因此同步到 VNDB 时只同步状态。
- **首次同步需要授权**：各平台同步需先在对应平台完成一次授权，之后会在后台自动使用。
- **Hikarinagi 登录**：已用旧方式登录过的老账号不受影响，仍会登录原来的账号；新登录会自动识别邮箱。
- **升级不影响存档**：本次更新不涉及引擎与存档逻辑，原有存档数据可正常读取。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

- **内置文件提取器**：现在可以直接从 MT 管理器等文件工具访问 YukiHub 的内部文件夹。
- **游戏库支持隐藏游戏**：新增「隐藏」分类，可以把不想出现在主列表里的游戏藏起来，需要时再恢复。

- **默认刮削源更换为 NextMoe**：相比 VNDB 数据更完整、匹配更准。
- **好友列表排序优化**：改为按最后上线时间排序，且**有未读消息的好友优先排在前面**。
- **KRKR 新增内部存储启动**（实验性）：部分游戏可能受益，目前效果有限，暂时保留。

## 🛠 问题修复

### FVP 引擎

- **同步上游源码修复**：修复部分贴图 bug；场景跳转开始带有转场效果。
- **修复《樱花萌放》Steam 官中版部分文本乱码**：已从引擎侧完成编码映射修复。
- **修复转场黑屏**：等待上游修复的转场黑屏问题已随本次同步解决。
- **修复《はっぴぃ☆マーガレット!》汉化问题**。
- **修复对话框背景白色不透明**：对话框背景现在会正确显示为半透明，且设置里的「窗口颜色」R/G/B/A 滑条**可实时生效**。
- **修复游戏爆音**：修正了音量与声道的单位换算错误，响度不再溢出削波。

## 📌 说明

- **隐藏游戏**：隐藏后的游戏会移入「隐藏」分类，可在该分类中随时恢复显示。
- **KRKR 内部存储启动**：属实验性功能，效果因游戏而异，如遇异常可改回原启动方式。
- **FVP 引擎更新仅涉及引擎侧**：不改变存档格式，原有存档可正常读取。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

# YukiHub v0.3.5 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**新引擎支持 · 大屏体验 · 社区互动 · 在线状态 · 稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **新增 PC 引擎**：支持兼容 **Winlator-CN** 快捷启动。使用方法：手动选择 PC 引擎 → 添加游戏文件夹 → 选择 exe 文件启动即可。（请确保已安装 **Winlator-CN 1005 或更新版本**）
- **新增 FVP 引擎兼容启动**：FVP 引擎正式可用。
- **大屏模式新增搜索功能**：位于分类栏最上方，支持按游戏名与会社名搜索。
- **社区接入 NextMoe 贴纸表情包**：现在可以更愉快地带表情包发言了（bushi）。
- **在线状态区分手机 / 电脑端**：在线标记已区别化显示，为 PC 端接入做好准备。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **FVP 引擎新增虚拟鼠标按钮**：复用 KRKR / Artemis 的虚拟鼠标方案，操作更顺手。

## 🛠 问题修复

- **修复扫描入库的游戏固定使用 VNDB 源的问题**：扫描入库后现在会按设置中选择的资料源进行匹配，与手动添加保持一致。
- **修复大屏模式游玩时长不计入网页端每日任务的问题**：大屏游玩现在会正常上报服务端，经验与每日任务均可正常结算。
- **修复设置面板上下滑动时选项被误判为点击、导致界面被"硬控"的问题**。
- **修复 FVP 引擎视频播放问题**：需手动将原游戏视频转换为标准 MP4 格式 —— 编码 **H.264 (AVC)**、音频 **AAC**；720p 推荐 4000 比特率，1080p 推荐 6000 比特率。
- **移除 Bangumi 镜像源**：因镜像源频繁失效，已正式下线；此前使用镜像源的用户升级后将**自动切换为 Bangumi 官源**（官源访问可能需要一点 🔮）。

## 📌 说明

- 网络类静默失败已补充日志记录，开启日志后更便于排查问题。
- 以上修复均不涉及引擎存档镜像逻辑，原有存档数据不受影响。

## What this release fixes · 本版修复

**EN**

- Porting some games stopped at the "GLSLC capture" stage with a build error
  and produced nothing (Eastward and Tokyo Xanadu eX+ were reported). The
  capture works again: games that compile their shaders at run time port
  through now.
- Pressing "Update runtime" on a game's page rebuilt the runtime without the
  game's per-build tables, and Unreal-engine games crashed at startup
  afterwards (FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, Octopath Traveler 0, DRAGON QUEST VII
  Reimagined). The rebuild carries the game's full build data now.
- The build page's progress reads correctly, and installing a game no longer
  retranslates every shader (@mijuu, #79).

**Before you update**: your games keep the runtime they have and play exactly
as before — the fixes take effect when you port again or press "Update
runtime". If a game of yours crashes at startup after a rebuild, press it once
more after updating: the game starts, and your saves were never at risk.

**中文**

- 一些游戏的移植停在"GLSLC capture"阶段并报构建错误、没有产物(已收到
  Eastward 与 Tokyo Xanadu eX+ 的报告)。现在可以正常通过:运行时自己编译
  着色器的游戏能移植了。

### The assistant is in the app

The app carries an assistant now. It runs on the phone itself, in the same
Linux environment the porting tools run in, so no computer is involved. Ask
it in your own words - why a game crashed, why a port would not build, what
is in the library - and it reads the game's log, the build's output and the
library's state by itself. It answers in the language you write to it.

A game that misbehaves goes to a case worker: it opens a case file for that
game - the symptom, the cause, the fix it proposes - and its steps are
visible while it works. A code change waits until you say yes. The knowledge
it diagnoses with ships inside the app: over 400 upstream porting cases,
sorted by what you see, searchable and offline.

To talk to a model the assistant needs one of your own: the Settings tab
takes a provider, a model and a key, and the key stays on the phone.
Without a key, everything else in the app works exactly as before.

### Porting on the phone

A merged dump - one file holding the base game, its update and the DLC
together - now ports as its own version; it could pick the wrong patch or

### The gamepad and the touch stick

The face buttons of a controller are one choice now: by position (the Switch's
layout - X on top, Y on the left, A on the right, B at the bottom) or by what
the controller prints. It is set per controller in the gamepad center and takes
effect at once. The per-key rebinding is gone: it needed a capture flow and a
binding table, players got lost in it, and a rebound button took another key's
source away without anyone seeing why. The center's scope shows what the game
receives, so pressing a button is the test.

The controller's axes are read the way that controller reports them. The Xbox
family (a USB xpad, a Bluetooth XInput pad) puts its triggers on Z/RZ and its
right stick on RX/RY - the opposite of the usual layout - so those pads'
triggers never fired and their right stick never reached the game. The app now
works the roles out of the device's own ranges.

The touch stick starts where the thumb lands: the offset is taken from the
point the finger went down, so a thumb on the rim has output right away. A
small dead zone around that point, the rim is the full deflection, and the
right stick is finer at low speed.

## Before you update · 更新之前(必读)

- (EN) This build fixes the runtime build on the phone. If you have not imported the profiles package of v0.4.0-alpha01 yet, you still must: the app runs the games on the new host (0.4.0), and the old package's packs were built for the previous one. Import it in the environment check (the "manage" box).
- (中文) 本版修复了手机上的运行库构建。如果你还没有导入 v0.4.0-alpha01 的档案包，现在仍然必须导入：App 用新宿主(0.4.0)运行游戏，旧档案包的数据包是按旧宿主构建的。到环境检查里(那个"管理"按钮)导入。

## Fixed: the runtime a game needs on the phone builds again

The new host (0.4.0) checks every profile's picture - the screenshot the README shows - and looked for it in the app's own tool folder, where the pictures are not shipped: the build failed with "readme_image 'docs/images/...': no such file in the repository", and every game whose profile names a picture could not be rebuilt. The check now runs where the pictures are (a checkout of the repository), and the app's own copy leaves it out. Sixty games had a picture in their profile: all of them build now.

The fix is in the app, so the runtime on the phone is rebuilt as soon as the app is updated. Nothing to import for this one.

## Before you update · 更新之前(必读)

- (EN) This release moves the packs onto a new host (0.4.0). After the app updates, you **must** import the new profiles package in the environment check (the "manage" box): the old package's packs were built for the previous host and will not work with this app. The app will remind you and point you there. Update the app first, then import the package - both steps are required.

## New games: NieR:Automata, Link's Awakening, Silver Pines

Three games join the profiles package:

- **NieR:Automata The End of YoRHa Edition** - boots with update 1.0.3, and the map is drawn correctly after loading a save. Broader gameplay checks are still pending, so expect rough edges.
- **The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening** - playable on update 1.1.0, verified on a Lenovo TB323FU. It runs at a dynamic 30/60 fps by default; the stable-60 option stays off (it can judder on weaker chips). It needs the firmware files.
- **Silver Pines** - the v65536 update (1.0.1) plays, verified on the Xiaomi 23117RK66C (Android 16).
